_readme: Data Quality assets of the Bid Desk. Rule specs: one string input 'Text', one output 'Output' = VALID | INVALID; each script is the IF / ELSEIF / ELSE text the rule builder stores. bid_dq.py clones the template rule spec named in config idmc.template_rule_spec (there is no create verb, KB DQ 01) and imports one package per rule. Profiles: one per table, one rule occurrence per (rule, column). Names keep the project prefix; profile names use '_' for '.' because a dot was refused in profile names.

rules.name: Required value filled in
rules.description: Bid response check. Every field a solicitation requires must be filled in before the bid goes out (vendor fields of a required form, the bid contact, each line's unit price and brand). VALID when filled in; INVALID when missing, empty, only spaces, or still the blank line of the agency's form (underscores only).
rules.script:
// required value: VALID when Text is filled in, INVALID when it is missing, empty or a blank form line
IF
// missing, empty or only spaces
 ISNULL(Text) OR LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(Text))) = 0 OR IS_SPACES(Text)
THEN Output = 'INVALID'
ELSEIF
// still the blank line of the form: underscores only
 REG_MATCH(Text, '^[_ ]+$')
THEN Output = 'INVALID'
ELSE Output = 'VALID'
ENDIF

rules.name: Item number (5 digits)
rules.description: Bid form check. Every line of the bid form carries the agency's own five-digit item number, the key it awards and orders by. VALID when exactly five digits; INVALID otherwise.
rules.script:
// item number: VALID when Text is exactly 5 digits, INVALID otherwise
IF
// missing
 ISNULL(Text)
THEN Output = 'INVALID'
ELSEIF
// exactly five digits
 REG_MATCH(LTRIM(RTRIM(Text)), '^[0-9]{5}$')
THEN Output = 'VALID'
ELSE Output = 'INVALID'
ENDIF

rules.name: Unit of measure on the bid form
rules.description: Bid form check. The agency bids and buys in its own units: EACH, CASE, 5-PK or 2-PK. VALID when the unit is one of those; INVALID when missing or another unit.
rules.script:
// unit of measure: VALID when Text is EACH, CASE, 5-PK or 2-PK, INVALID otherwise
IF
// missing
 ISNULL(Text)
THEN Output = 'INVALID'
ELSEIF
// one of the bid form's units (any letter case, spaces ignored)
 IN(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Text))), ['EACH', 'CASE', '5-PK', '2-PK'])
THEN Output = 'VALID'
ELSE Output = 'INVALID'
ENDIF

rules.name: Quantity above zero
rules.description: Bid form check. The yearly quantity arrives as text read from the PDF; it must be a whole number above zero.
rules.script:
// quantity: VALID when Text is a whole number above 0, INVALID otherwise
IF
// missing or not a whole number
 ISNULL(Text) OR NOT REG_MATCH(LTRIM(RTRIM(Text)), '^[0-9]+$')
THEN Output = 'INVALID'
ELSEIF
// above zero
 TO_INTEGER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Text))) > 0
THEN Output = 'VALID'
ELSE Output = 'INVALID'
ENDIF

rules.name: Price with at most two decimals
rules.description: Bid form check. The agency counts only two decimal places and rounds anything longer up. VALID when a filled-in price has at most two decimals (24.85, $24.85, 24); INVALID with three or more (6.345) or not a price. An empty price is judged by 'Required value filled in'.
rules.script:
// price decimals: VALID when Text is a price with at most 2 decimals or empty, INVALID otherwise
IF
// empty: judged by the required-value rule
 ISNULL(Text) OR LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(Text))) = 0 OR IS_SPACES(Text)
THEN Output = 'VALID'
ELSEIF
// a price with at most two decimals, $ optional
 REG_MATCH(LTRIM(RTRIM(Text)), '^[$]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]{1,2})?$')
THEN Output = 'VALID'
ELSE Output = 'INVALID'
ENDIF

rules.name: E-mail address format
rules.description: Bid response check. Every e-mail address on a bid must be well formed so the agency can reach the bidder. VALID when a filled-in address is well formed; INVALID when not. Empty is judged by 'Required value filled in'.
rules.script:
// e-mail format: VALID when Text is a well-formed address or empty, INVALID otherwise
IF
// empty: judged by the required-value rule
 ISNULL(Text) OR LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(Text))) = 0 OR IS_SPACES(Text) OR REG_MATCH(Text, '^[_ ]+$')
THEN Output = 'VALID'
ELSEIF
// a well-formed address
 REG_MATCH(LTRIM(RTRIM(Text)), '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9-]+([.][A-Za-z0-9-]+)*[.][A-Za-z]{2,}$')
THEN Output = 'VALID'
ELSE Output = 'INVALID'
ENDIF

rules.name: Product number on one line
rules.description: Document-reading check. A brand and product number printed across two lines of a PDF cell can come out split by the line break (ACME BH- 24548 instead of ACME BH-24548). VALID when there is no such break. Silver re-joins it, so Bronze shows the raw reading and Silver the corrected one.
rules.script:
// product number: VALID when Text has no dash split by a line break, INVALID otherwise
IF
// empty
 ISNULL(Text)
THEN Output = 'VALID'
ELSEIF
// a dash followed by a space: a line break in the PDF cell
 REG_MATCH(Text, '.*- .*')
THEN Output = 'INVALID'
ELSE Output = 'VALID'
ENDIF
